title: The 2024 Polish JASSM-ER order remains scheduled without a public delivery or acceptance record
source_unit: Official Polish procurement page, schedule-vintage briefing, historical delivery comparator, and current-source non-observation audit
geography: Poland and US-origin JASSM-ER procurement relationship

denominator.unit: Polish Ministry of National Defence JASSM-ER agreement page

agreement_value.unit: US dollars millions, approximate reported value

observations.method: Fresh official-page recheck and preserved local HTML capture; agreement, value, schedule, and missing realization fields are recorded separately.
observations.uncertainty: Absence of a delivery statement on the reviewed page is not proof that no delivery occurred elsewhere; the page is a procurement announcement, not a complete inventory system.
observations.counterinterpretation: A delivery or training event may have been reported under a different program label or not publicly released.

denominator.unit: Polish Ministry of National Defence modernization briefing

later_schedule.unit: years stated in the JASSM discussion

observations.method: Separate official briefing retained as schedule context rather than interpreted as an amendment or delivery notice.
observations.uncertainty: The wording may refer to a related missile schedule, lot, or planning stage; no lot identifier or contract modification is reported.
observations.counterinterpretation: The apparent conflict may disappear once variant, lot, and delivery tranche are identified.

denominator.unit: reviewed official Polish and US source set for the 2024 order

observations.method: Targeted search/recheck of official Polish MOD, US DSCA/DoD, and relevant force/integration sources for a dated 2026 event; non-observation is bounded to the reviewed public set.
observations.uncertainty: The result cannot establish that no delivery occurred; it establishes only that the reviewed public sources did not support a delivery/acceptance claim.
observations.subgroup: 2024 JASSM-ER order, distinguished from earlier JASSM stock and other Polish missile programs.
observations.counterinterpretation: Operational or logistical records may be unpublished, delayed, or labeled under a broader modernization or air-force program.

related_sources.claim: Current-source watchpoint documents the reviewed non-observation and schedule conflict.
US production-support and integration milestones do not substitute for Polish customer delivery.
Possible-sale approval is an earlier procurement stage, not delivery.

boundary: This record preserves a dated public-source non-observation. It does not prove no delivery occurred; it does establish that the reviewed official sources do not support promoting the 2024 JASSM-ER order to accepted, delivered, fielded, or operational capability.
